# ASM Asset Management

> SEBI-registered Mutual Fund (Asset Management Company) offering
> gold and multi-asset schemes for Indian retail investors.

- Type: SEBI-registered Mutual Fund (Asset Management Company)
- SEBI Registration: MF/879/25/2
- Registered Name: [FULL LEGAL NAME — to be filled by operator]
- Brand: ASM Coins
- Website: https://www.asmcoins.com
- Country: India
- Regulator: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

## Schemes Offered

- ASM Gold Fund: Open-ended gold fund (Gold ETF Fund of Funds) for
  long-term capital appreciation through gold exposure.
- ASM Multi-Asset Fund: Open-ended multi-asset allocation fund investing
  in equity, debt, and gold (minimum 10% each) for balanced growth.

## Risk Disclosure

Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks.
Read all scheme-related documents carefully before investing.
Returns are not guaranteed.
Past performance does not guarantee future results.
